p: Ar of Moab is laid waste: The chief city by which the whole country was meant.
He is gone up to Bajith: The Moabites will flee to their idols for comfort but it will be too late.
Nebo: Which were cites of Moab.
their heads shall be baldness: For as in the west parts the people used to let their hair grow long when they mourned, so in the East part they cut it off.
heart shall cry out for Moab: The prophet speaks this in the person of the Moabites: or as one who felt the great judgment of God that God would come on them.
an heifer of three years old: Meaning that it was a city that always lived in pleasure and never felt sorrow.
shall raise a cry of destruction: He describes the miserable dissipation and flight of the Moabites.
brook of the willows: To hide themselves and their goods there.
of blood: Of them who are slain.
upon him that escapeth of Moab: So that by no means would they escape the hand of God: thus will God punish the enemies of his Church.
